Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to identify that the correct answer is "Figaro-Ci, Figaro-Là" based on the directors' birth years. After gathering the data (Reginald Le Borg born 1902 and Hervé Bromberger born 1918), the Planner repeatedly instructed the WebSurfer to calculate the age at the *time of release* (1948 vs 1972) rather than comparing the directors' absolute birth years to determine who is "younger." This flawed methodology led to an incorrect conclusion or a failure to reach the correct conclusion because comparing the age of a 46-year-old (Le Borg in 1948) to a 54-year-old (Bromberger in 1972) incorrectly suggests the older person is the "younger director" in relative terms, whereas the question asks for the director who was born later (younger in absolute age). The Planner's instruction to compare "ages at the time of release" instead of "birth years" is the root cause of the error.
